item.title: Honoring Veterans Day: Stories of Service, Leadership, and Innovation at HiddenLayer
item.description:
Date: November 11, 2025
Tags: ["Veterans Day", "Cybersecurity", "Military to Civilian Career Transition", "Leadership", "Technology and Innovation"]
Summary:
  • HiddenLayer honors veterans on Veterans Day.
  • Two team members, Travis and Kevin, have military backgrounds.
  • Their service shapes their cybersecurity work.
  • Military values guide their leadership and innovation.
  • HiddenLayer supports veterans transitioning to tech careers.
  • The company values resilience, teamwork, and accountability.
